structured.answer: Open the account at Psagot (פסגות). It's ranked cheapest, about 1,058 ₪ over 10 years. But the site has no funds for my 'test' index, so I still don't know which fund to buy or what its management fee costs; I'd have to add a fund myself and I don't know which one.

stuck.where: Box 'כמה נשאר בסוף תלוי בקרן' and the fund panel 'עוד לא נבחרה קרן'
stuck.why: I came to find the cheapest way into my index, but there's no fund for 'test'. It wants me to add one, and I don't know which fund to add.
These aren't my amounts (I have 30,000), so I'm not sure the shekel figures apply to me
I didn't know what the colours mean. I glanced at the key at the very bottom once and guessed.
